title: Resin ashore, rosewater afloat
body: Ismail sends the Salamat out to a neighbouring roadstead while the fleet's captains decide whether to sail together. He has left several crates of frankincense in a rented store in Melaka. He will not risk all his goods on one tide, he says, and he won't tell the crew which rumour to believe.
notes: inference: Leaving goods in a rented store while a ship moves to a nearby anchorage is a plausible precaution, not a documented episode (docs/research/port-official.md §3)
gameplay: The roadstead, decision and timing are fictional; this is not a voyage to Cambay and back (data/merchants/khoja_ismail.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§08–09)
